line: === PRIZE WHEEL (correctness redesign) ===
# build: v2-capture-pulsefirst-20260920; based on gentle6
[ / ] one-shot encoder-dir -1 / +1; ! sticky abort; no automatic rearm
z  set current raw as wedge-0 anchor (wheel at rest, pointer on 11|0 line)
p  attended two-leg direction probe (safe wedge center only)
s  status
d  arm high-rate RAM capture (dumps after true stop/fault)
D  dump current trace at rest with outputs disabled
v  toggle live control logs
e  toggle automatic takeover
f  print friction model
F  reset friction model to seeds
x  clear stored direction calibration
r  disabled build only: acknowledge preserved trace, recover known SELFSPIN_ABORT
m  print dare mask
?  help
--- party additions ---
t  FX/WiFi loop-budget max-tracker (resets window)
a  audio on/off   l  LEDs on/off   w  network status
V<n>+Enter  DFPlayer volume 0-30 (e.g. V18)
